text.p: Creditanstalt, Austria's number two bank, said on Thursday operating profit in the first nine months of the year rose 9.8 percent to 4.65 billion schillings, helped by strong business in its foreign subsidiaries.
Creditanstalt said it expects full-year net profit to rise about 20 percent above last year's 2.16 billion schillings.

Creditanstalt said operating income rose 9.6 percent to 13.9 billion schillings, boosted by a 10.8 percent increase in net interest income to 7.7 billion as a result of a strong gain in foreign currency business.
Net commission income rose 8.7 percent to 3.0 billion schillings, while trading profit was up 14.1 percent at 1.35 billion schillings, Creditanstalt said.
Total assets rose 7.5 percent to 693.12 billion schillings.

Creditanstalt has topped the government's privatisation list for six years. The finance ministry earlier this week called for renewed bids on its 70 percent voting stake in the country's flagship bank by November 15.
Creditanstalt, mirroring similar statements by the government, said it expects the sale of the bank to be finalised before the end of the year.
